title: Number of Subsequences with Odd Sum
summary: For an array nums, calculate the count of subsequences whose sum of elements is odd, then return this count modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: For an array nums, calculate the count of subsequences whose sum of elements is odd, then return this count modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Subsequences preserve order and are distinguished by selected indices.
hints: Maintain counts of nonempty even- and odd-sum subsequences.
Odd values swap parity when appended; even values preserve it. Add the singleton and reduce modulo M.
